test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Padmapani Bodhisattva’ is a mural painting found in _________ caves.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajanta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Late 5th century, **most likely 477, **Bodhisattva Padmapani **from **cave 1 **at **Ajanta monastery **in **central India**.
 
• Early medieval India produced this **magnificent mural artwork**, which was **preserved inside the Buddhist rock-cut monastery of Ajanta**.
 
• **Ajanta**, a **Buddhist hamlet in Maharashtra**, **is close to Aurangabad**.
 
 
• This **was found by British soldiers **in a **horseshoe-shaped mountainside **where **29 caverns **have been **carved out**.
 
• There have been discovered **artwork in six of these caves**.
 
• The caverns come in **two different chaitya **and **vihara varieties**.
 
 
 
• **A Bodhisattva, **or someone on the **way to becoming a Buddha**, is **Padmapani.**
 
 
• He is **an iconic figure **in **Buddhist imagery **and the **personification of compassion**.
 
• He is **referred **to **as Padmapani**, or "**One who holds a lotus in his palm**," in Indian representations where he is **shown holding the Padma, or lotus flower**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pre-Buddha caves **are those that have **artwork **that was **produced prior to the Ajanta and Bagh Caves**. The **Jogimara cave**, which is located in **Sarguja in Chhattisgarh at Amarnath **close to the source of **the Narmada**, is an outstanding example of pre-Buddhist art.
 
• **One of the greatest prehistoric complexes **may be found at the **Bhimbetka site**, which also **houses the oldest known rock art in India**. The **mysterious primitive animal Dickinsonia **is among the **fossils from the Precambrian**, **hundreds of millions **of years before the **human era**, that may be found in the **Bhimbetka caves**.
 
• **It is renowned for both its structure temples**, such as the **Bhutanatha temples**, **Badami Shivalaya**, and **Jambulingesvara temple**, as well as its rock-cut monuments, such as the **Badami cave temples**. It is situated at the base of **a rough, red sandstone outcrop **that encircles Agastya lake, in a ravine.
